examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The `split` close the solution pages end with: the headline and the white button in the lead cell, the sentence and the outlined button in the aside cell, over the tall closing frame. Edit the props in the Controls panel — a band with no title renders nothing.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import ClosingCallToAction from '@aziontech/webkit/closing-call-to-action'

  const primaryAction = {
    label: 'Start for free',
    href: 'https://console.azion.com/signup?tck=build_cta'
  }

  const secondaryAction = {
    label: 'Talk to a specialist',
    href: 'https://www.azion.com/en/contact/',
    trailing: true
  }
</script>

<template>
  <ClosingCallToAction
    kind="split"
    anchor="contact"
    eyebrow="Build"
    title="Build once."
    title-muted="Run everywhere."
    description="Get a faster path to launch, lower latency, and less infrastructure overhead."
    :primary-action="primaryAction"
    :secondary-action="secondaryAction"
  />
</template>
